name: python-consistent-hashing
title: A consistent hash ring whose movement you can audit
blurb: A blake2b hash ring with weighted virtual nodes, plus an audit that measures the two claims every ring makes: adding a node moves one share and not everything (the same 5,000 keys through hash % N move ~83% while the ring moves ~17%), and the virtual-node count is what decides how even the split is (1.00 versus 0.98 imbalance is printed, not asserted). Removal is proved to move only the departing node's keys, insertion order is proved not to matter, and `move` gates on a limit so a topology change is a checked operation.
default_description: A consistent hash ring with weighted virtual nodes, where every claim about movement and balance is measured.
